verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Jitsu's self-hosting, security/compliance, and data-pipeline features extensively, but contains no mention of an opt-out flag, setting, or documentation for disabling Jitsu's own product/CLI usage telemetry sent back to Jitsu Inc. Self-hosting (jitsu-docs-14, jitsu-docs-41) addresses customer analytics data sovereignty, not the product's own telemetry practices.
